base: 51-driver core set, September 2026 review (release 2.11.0, owner ruling O10/O11)
method: v3.1 methodology: weighted Jaccard on 12-category exposure vectors, excess over J0, asymmetric force-size factor (cross-force), per-cell mechanism adjustments re-judged for the 51-driver population, clamps within [0.10, 0.45] and cross [0.00, 0.45], eff_att = 0.5 x (1 - mean cross-force row overlap)

within_force_mechanism_reason.Consumer: 20 drivers, one mechanism each after the review (duplicated regional lines, GLP-1 shedding, longevity claims consolidated); residual premium-hair (C-03/C-04/C-07/C-02), value (C-01/C-06/C-11/C-35) and demographic (C-05/C-25/C-18/C-34) clusters act on different P&L lines or regions; empirical excess 0, floor 0.10 applies, no adjustment
within_force_mechanism_reason.Customer: K-01 discounters, K-12 drugstores, K-03 buyer power and K-13 retail media all compress the same European trade margin on the same LHC volume; kept separate because the channels differ, but the P&L line is one
within_force_mechanism_reason.Technology: T-11 AI agents, T-13 generative search and T-08 platform replenishment are one digital-intermediation cluster (three of six drivers); the high raw overlap also reflects category-broad vectors, so the adjustment stays at the v3.5 level
within_force_mechanism_reason.Government: six of ten drivers come out of one legislative programme (microplastics, PPWR/EPR, EmpCo, EUDR/CSDDD, Detergents Regulation, UWWTD) and G-04, G-16 and G-17 stack compliance cost on the same detergent SKUs; the review removed the triple count of the packaging stack, the cluster remains
within_force_mechanism_reason.Environmental: four COGS-side cost drivers on the same European manufactured volume; E-07 energy, E-12 oil feedstock and E-03 carbon move with the same 2026 energy shock
within_force_mechanism_reason.Competitive: four drivers with distinct actors and mechanisms (scale leaders, challengers, share windows, salon channel); empirical excess 0, floor 0.10 applies, no adjustment
